title.narrative: Promoting Climate Resilience and Sustainable Livelihoods in Nampula

description.narrative: The project aims to address severe climate impacts, food insecurity and persistent gender inequalities in Angoche, Nampula. Its purpose is to strengthen community, environmental and livelihood resilience, empower women and girls, and promote climate justice and the right to food. Livaningo will use local, participatory strategies to restore livelihoods, enhance biodiversity, support women's agency, and improve monitoring to guide effective, sustainable action. The project will intervene in four main areas namely: (i) Stronger organizations,(ii) Gender Equality and Women's Rights,(iii): Resilience, healthy environment, and climate and (iv) Sustainable livelihoods. The project targets 1,540 rural people (60% women), including women, men, youth and people with disabilities, organised in community groups and associations. Main activities include establishing emergency funds, enforcing GBV/PSEAH policies, and strengthening MEAL systems. The project will create RACs, deliver awareness campaigns, update strategic documents, and train staff in governance, leadership, fundraising, and anti-corruption. It will expand partnerships, promote youth and disability inclusion, support business development and financial access, train VSLAs in digital tools, empower women economically, and advance sustainable, diversified agriculture.
